reuse.why: Tag detection uses the shared extractTagsFromText, and every action except copyPreviousMonth gets the exclusion through the existing getMonthWideCategories selection.

duplication.why: The predicate is defined once, but the group-notes join and the exclusion check are added to both getBudgetData/copyPreviousMonth and getMonthWideCategories, extending the pre-existing parallel filter in copyPreviousMonth rather than routing it through the shared selection.

placement.why: The rule sits beside the month-wide selection helper in budget/actions.ts; adding group_note to the generic getBudgetData query leaks a month-wide concern into a general data loader.

scope.why: Only the exclusion, its data plumbing, a test and a release note.

maintainability.why: Named predicate and constant make the rule clear; a maintainer still has to keep copyPreviousMonth's own inline filter list in step with getMonthWideCategories.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses extractTagsFromText; copyPreviousMonth's separate filtering predates the change and calls the same predicate.

disguised_duplication.where: The second join/check in getBudgetData and copyPreviousMonth is a visible parallel of the getMonthWideCategories one, not disguised.

one_place.where: actions.ts isFixedCostGroupNote is the single definition, used by getMonthWideCategories (setZero, averages, last-month spending) and by copyPreviousMonth's own filter; the group-note join is repeated in getBudgetData.
